Container.Name: birdnet-go-frame
Container.Overview: Draws the birds your BirdNET-Go has heard as a collage of 1800s plates and serves it to a six-colour e-ink panel (and any browser). A single static binary in a scratch image, about 2 MB. Set BIRDNET_URL to your BirdNET-Go, or to mock to try it without one.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Where the panel and your browser reach the frame. BirdNET-Go usually holds 8080.

Config.Name: BirdNET-Go URL
Config.Description: BirdNET-Go's address as the container sees it, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080. mock draws a simulated garden.

Config.Name: Time zone offset
Config.Description: The garden's time zone in minutes east of UTC (60 for Sweden in winter, 120 in summer). Not adjusted for daylight saving.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Language of the page's own words: en, sv, nb, da, fi, de, nl, fr, es, it, pl, pt. Bird names follow BirdNET-Go's setting.

Config.Name: Art folder
Config.Description: Where fugleramme's plates are, once fetched (see the how-to). Read only.

Config.Name: Art style
Config.Description: Leave empty for generated birds. Set to /art/classic once the plates are fetched into the art folder.

Config.Name: Panel
Config.Description: 13.3 or 7.3: the panel served to clients that do not name one.

Config.Name: Rotation
Config.Description: 0, 90, 180 or 270: how the panel hangs. 90 and 270 are portrait.

Config.Name: Poll minutes
Config.Description: How long the panel sleeps between checks.

Config.Name: Window hours
Config.Description: How far back detections count, rounded out to whole days.

Config.Name: Names
Config.Description: Whether the collage writes each bird's name under it.

Config.Name: Most birds
Config.Description: Most birds on a page, most heard first. 0 shows every bird heard.
